messages:
Sam (Product Marketing): Quick planning note 1: webinar 2026-04-12 17:00 PT. Need X + LinkedIn teaser sequence, two creative tracks to A/B: numbers-first (performance snapshots + micro-chart) vs customer-quote (short testimonial + outcome). Test CTAs: 'Register' vs 'Watch recording'. Need hero PNG, 20s silent clip, and animated GIF. Also want short reply scripts for high-intent and a basic paid-amplification budget ask. Who owns assets and copy?

Ivy (Social Ops): I can run scheduling & paid. Proposed publish cadence (UTC): X A (numbers) 2026-04-08T14:00Z, LinkedIn B (quote) 2026-04-09T18:00Z, X B (quote) 2026-04-10T14:00Z, LinkedIn A (numbers) 2026-04-11T18:00Z. Will set up a small paid boost for top-performing variant on 4/09. Shortlink: rdw.ai/0426web. Avoid maintenance window 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC.

Derek (Content): I'll produce: two 4-tweet threads, two LinkedIn drafts (800-1000 chars + TL;DR), reply templates (info, tech, sales), and a one-line hook for pinned reply. Upload ETA: 2026-04-01 16:00 PT to /Marketing/Events/webinar-apr-2026/assets. Assets: hero_v2.png, clip20s_v2.mp4 (silent), gif_snip_v1.gif. Will keep music-free to simplify licensing.

Ravi (Growth): Routing plan: Zapier -> HubSpot. Pipeline: webinar_social_apr2026. Handoff rules: if comment/DM matches /(pricing|demo|enterprise|rfp|contract|trial)/i OR contains a company domain -> tag high-intent; follower_count>1000 -> medium. UTM: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_apr2026&utm_content={variant}_{cta}. I'll draft the Zap and HubSpot stage mapping today. Also propose auto-DM for demo/pricing exact-match: "Thanks! Please DM your work email or register rdw.ai/0426web and our SDR will follow up."

social-bot: Reminder: Verify clip consent and confirm any partner logo usage by 2026-04-02. Consent checkbox on reg form set: TRUE.

Ivy (Social Ops): Engagement play: pin registration reply for 48h, two proactive follow-ups within 24h (1: extra stat + slide image, 2: clear CTA to register/book). I'll brief 4 internal advocates to amplify on 4/09 morning. Need copy by Derek by 4/1 16:00 PT to schedule.

Sam (Product Marketing): Good. Action items: Derek uploads copy + assets by 4/1 16:00 PT; Ivy to queue and share social queue links; Ravi shares Zapier mapping; social-bot to confirm license by 4/2. Quick sync 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks team! :rocket:
